name: GPU-based Marching Tetrahedra with Adaptive Tessellation
definition: A two-pass GPU method for isosurface extraction that separates domain voxelization/tetrahedralization from polygon generation to maximize SIMD utilization and reduce register pressure compared to Marching Cubes.
summary: GPU-based Marching Tetrahedra with Adaptive Tessellation is a real-time isosurface extraction method that uses a two-pass GPU approach to separate tetrahedralization from polygon generation, reducing register pressure and maximizing parallelism.
